label: Salt & Cedar, a day spa
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;1,500&family=Jost:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');
  /* Salt & Cedar: a day spa in a 1912 municipal bathhouse. One 78rem grid on full-width bands; Cormorant for the
     voice, Jost for everything you read twice. The details only a spa has: minutes on the table, the temperature of
     every room, the quiet hours and the next infusion. */
  #in-spa {
    --background: oklch(0.965 0.006 80);
    --foreground: oklch(0.23 0.012 60);
    --card: oklch(0.99 0.004 80);
    --card-foreground: oklch(0.23 0.012 60);
    --popover: oklch(0.99 0.004 80);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.23 0.012 60);
    --muted: oklch(0.93 0.008 80);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.014 60);
    --border: oklch(0.23 0.012 60 / 0.13);
    --input: oklch(0.23 0.012 60 / 0.26);
    --primary: oklch(0.36 0.03 55);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.97 0.006 80);
    --secondary: oklch(0.92 0.012 75);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.28 0.02 60);
    --accent: oklch(0.925 0.01 75);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.23 0.012 60);
    --ring: oklch(0.5 0.05 55);
    --radius: 0.375rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --sp-band: oklch(0.935 0.01 78);
    --sp-sign: oklch(0.8 0.055 70);
    --sp-sign-ink: oklch(0.25 0.03 50);
    --sp-paper: oklch(0.99 0.006 85);
    --sp-paper-ink: oklch(0.25 0.015 60);
    --sp-seal: oklch(0.45 0.05 55);
    --sp-hot: oklch(0.6 0.13 40);
    --sp-cold: oklch(0.6 0.08 230);
    --sp-display: 'Cormorant', 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif;
    color-scheme: light;
    container: in-spa / inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      400 1rem/1.6 'Jost',
      var(--font-sans);
  }
  #in-spa[data-look='eucalyptus'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.962 0.014 160);
    --foreground: oklch(0.25 0.035 175);
    --card: oklch(0.985 0.008 160);
    --card-foreground: oklch(0.25 0.035 175);
    --popover: oklch(0.985 0.008 160);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.25 0.035 175);
    --muted: oklch(0.93 0.02 160);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.43 0.04 170);
    --border: oklch(0.25 0.035 175 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.25 0.035 175 / 0.27);
    --primary: oklch(0.42 0.07 170);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.97 0.012 160);
    --secondary: oklch(0.92 0.03 160);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.05 172);
    --accent: oklch(0.915 0.025 160);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.25 0.035 175);
    --ring: oklch(0.5 0.08 170);
    --radius: 1rem;
    --sp-band: oklch(0.93 0.022 158);
    --sp-sign: oklch(0.86 0.05 150);
    --sp-sign-ink: oklch(0.26 0.04 170);
    --sp-paper: oklch(0.985 0.012 150);
    --sp-paper-ink: oklch(0.26 0.04 170);
    --sp-seal: oklch(0.45 0.08 165);
    --sp-hot: oklch(0.6 0.12 45);
    --sp-cold: oklch(0.58 0.08 210);
  }
  #in-spa[data-look='night'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.17 0.03 255);
    --foreground: oklch(0.93 0.015 240);
    --card: oklch(0.21 0.035 255);
    --card-foreground: oklch(0.93 0.015 240);
    --popover: oklch(0.21 0.035 255);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.93 0.015 240);
    --muted: oklch(0.24 0.035 255);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.76 0.03 245);
    --border: oklch(0.93 0.015 240 / 0.13);
    --input: oklch(0.93 0.015 240 / 0.24);
    --primary: oklch(0.82 0.11 75);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.18 0.03 255);
    --secondary: oklch(0.26 0.04 255);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.9 0.02 240);
    --accent: oklch(0.27 0.04 255);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.93 0.015 240);
    --ring: oklch(0.82 0.11 75);
    --radius: 0.625rem;
    --sp-band: oklch(0.2 0.033 255);
    --sp-sign: oklch(0.82 0.11 75);
    --sp-sign-ink: oklch(0.2 0.03 255);
    --sp-paper: oklch(0.24 0.04 255);
    --sp-paper-ink: oklch(0.93 0.02 240);
    --sp-seal: oklch(0.82 0.11 75);
    --sp-hot: oklch(0.78 0.13 55);
    --sp-cold: oklch(0.75 0.08 230);
  }
  #in-spa [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-spa[data-look='stone'] .sp-look-only[data-for='stone'],
  #in-spa[data-look='eucalyptus'] .sp-look-only[data-for='eucalyptus'],
  #in-spa[data-look='night'] .sp-look-only[data-for='night'] {
    display: block;
  }
  /* one grid: every band runs full width, its content on a 78rem column */
  #in-spa > :is(section, footer) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem);
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
  }
  #in-spa > .sp-band {
    background: var(--sp-band);
  }
  #in-spa > section {
    scroll-margin-top: 4.5rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sheet-footer.mk-header-sheet-actions {
    display: grid;
  }
  #in-spa :is(h1, h2, h3) {
    font-family: var(--sp-display);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }
  #in-spa :is(a, button, input, select, textarea, summary):focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-section-header {
    margin-block-end: 2.5rem;
    padding-inline: 0;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-section-header-eyebrow {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-section-header-title {
    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.5rem + 2.6cqi, 3.25rem);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.05;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-section-header-desc {
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
  }
  /* the header: name left, the sections, then the look, the mode and Book */
  #in-spa .mk-header {
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 90%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
  #in-spa .mk-header-inner {
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.75rem;
    padding-block: 0.75rem;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
  }
  #in-spa .mk-header-brand {
    gap: 0.6rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-spa .mk-header-brand svg {
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-spa .mk-header-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 600 1.625rem/1 var(--sp-display);
    letter-spacing: 0;
  }
  #in-spa .nav-menu-link {
    padding-inline: 0.625rem;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-header-actions {
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-header-actions .select {
    width: auto;
  }
  #in-spa .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-spa .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 68rem) {
    #in-spa .mk-header-nav {
      display: none;
    }
    #in-spa .mk-header-menu {
      display: inline-flex;
    }
    #in-spa .mk-header-actions .mk-header-wide {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 26rem) {
    #in-spa .mk-header-name {
      font-size: 1.375rem;
    }
    #in-spa .mk-header-brand svg {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  /* the hero: the promise beside the pool window, today's temperatures on a hanging sign */
  #in-spa .sp-hero {
    padding-block: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem) clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem);
    gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6cqi, 5rem);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-hero .mk-hero-badge {
    border: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: none;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-hero .mk-hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(3rem, 1.6rem + 4.6cqi, 5.5rem);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 0.98;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-hero .mk-hero-title em {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-style: italic;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-hero .mk-hero-desc {
    max-width: 33rem;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-facts {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem 2rem;
    margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
    padding-block-start: 1.25rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-facts div {
    display: grid;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-facts dt {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-facts dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-window-wrap {
    position: relative;
    justify-self: center;
    width: min(100%, 30rem);
    padding: 1.5rem 0 2rem 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-window {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    margin: 0;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 10px solid var(--sp-band);
    background: oklch(0.55 0.06 215);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 1px var(--border),
      0 30px 60px -30px oklch(0.2 0.03 240 / 0.45);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-mullions {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    color: var(--sp-band);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-window figcaption {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    inset: auto 0 0;
    padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem 1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(transparent, oklch(0.15 0.03 240 / 0.6));
    color: oklch(0.98 0.01 220);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    text-align: end;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-lily {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 3;
    inset: auto auto 0 0;
    width: 36%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 6px solid var(--background);
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-lily img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-sign {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 4;
    inset: 0 -0.5rem auto auto;
    width: 11.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 2.25rem 1rem 0.9rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--sp-sign);
    color: var(--sp-sign-ink);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px oklch(0.2 0.03 50 / 0.5);
    transform-origin: 50% -2.5rem;
    rotate: 4deg;
    animation: sp-sway 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-sign::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: -2.5rem auto auto 50%;
    width: 1px;
    height: 3.25rem;
    background: currentColor;
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-sign::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0.7rem auto auto calc(50% - 0.3rem);
    width: 0.6rem;
    height: 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--background);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-sign h2 {
    margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    line-height: 1.1;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-sign dl {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    gap: 0.15rem 0.75rem;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-sign dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  @keyframes sp-sway {
    from {
      rotate: 2.5deg;
    }
    to {
      rotate: 5deg;
    }
  }
  /* the treatment menu: a filter, then every treatment with its minutes as a share of two hours */
  #in-spa .mk-filter-bar {
    margin-block-end: 1.75rem;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-filter-bar form {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    row-gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-filter-bar-chip {
    height: 2.5rem;
    padding-inline: 1.1rem;
    border-color: var(--input);
    background: var(--background);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-filter-bar-chip:has(:checked) {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  #in-spa .mk-filter-bar-count {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-menu {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 32rem), 1fr));
    gap: 0 3.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-spa:has([name='sp-cat'][value='massage']:checked) .sp-treat:not([data-cat='massage']),
  #in-spa:has([name='sp-cat'][value='facial']:checked) .sp-treat:not([data-cat='facial']),
  #in-spa:has([name='sp-cat'][value='body']:checked) .sp-treat:not([data-cat='body']),
  #in-spa:has([name='sp-cat'][value='ritual']:checked) .sp-treat:not([data-cat='ritual']) {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-treat {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    align-items: start;
    gap: 0.25rem 1.25rem;
    padding-block: 1.5rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-dur {
    --_deg: calc(var(--min) / 120 * 360deg);
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    place-content: center;
    width: 3.75rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: conic-gradient(var(--primary) var(--_deg), color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent) 0);
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-dur::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 4px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sp-band);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-dur :is(b, small) {
    position: relative;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-dur b {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-dur small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-treat-cat {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-treat h3 {
    margin: 0.1rem 0 0.35rem;
    font-size: 1.625rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-treat-desc {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-treat-side {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: end;
    gap: 0.6rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-price {
    font: 600 1.625rem/1 var(--sp-display);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-price small {
    display: block;
    margin-block-start: 0.2rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font:
      400 0.75rem/1.2 'Jost',
      sans-serif;
    text-align: end;
  }
  /* day packages: the Pricing block on our grid */
  #in-spa .mk-pricing {
    max-width: none;
    padding-inline: 0;
    gap: 0;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-plan-title {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-plan-amount {
    font-family: var(--sp-display);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-plan-icon svg {
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-plan .badge {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  /* booking */
  #in-spa .mk-booking-form-group legend {
    font: 600 1.375rem/1.2 var(--sp-display);
  }
  #in-spa .mk-booking-form-option {
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #in-spa .mk-booking-form-option .avatar {
    width: 2.75rem;
    height: 2.75rem;
  }
  #in-spa .mk-booking-form-slot span {
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #in-spa .mk-booking-form-summary {
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-spa .mk-booking-form-summary .sp-summary-line {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-treat-info {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  /* the gift voucher: a form beside the voucher it makes */
  #in-spa .sp-voucher-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
    align-items: start;
    gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6cqi, 5rem);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-form {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-field {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    min-width: 0;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-field legend {
    margin-block-end: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-field small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-pair {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 12rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-chips {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-delivery {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-delivery label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-delivery label:has(:checked) {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--primary);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-delivery span {
    display: grid;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-delivery small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-voucher-stage {
    position: sticky;
    top: 6.5rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4cqi, 3rem) clamp(1rem, 3cqi, 2.5rem);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--sp-band);
  }
  #in-spa .sp-voucher-stage figcaption {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #in-spa .sp-voucher {
    --shape-cut: 0.9rem;
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 7.5rem;
    min-height: 17rem;
    background: var(--sp-paper);
    color: var(--sp-paper-ink);
    rotate: -2deg;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 22px oklch(0.2 0.02 60 / 0.18));
  }
  #in-spa .sp-voucher-main {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
